name: Craftsman's Writ: Colorful Kilt
summary: A customer seeks a disguise for slipping into Zul'Gurub, and Craftsman's Writ: Colorful Kilt names the garment they want.

sections.title: A disguise
sections.body: The transferable writ asks you to bring one Colorful Kilt to the marked location. The customer plans to pass through Zul'Gurub's gates dressed as one of its ritualists, and says the kilt suits the disguise.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one Colorful Kilt, to be delivered to the location marked on your map.

faq.q: Why does the customer want a colorful kilt?
faq.answer: The customer plans to sneak into Zul'Gurub dressed as one of its ritualists and says the kilt will help.
Yes. The writ says it is transferable.

faq.q: Where should I deliver the kilt?
faq.answer: The writ directs you to the location marked on your map.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Colorful Kilt
